purpose: BUG-019 live diagnostic capture (PLAN-2026-W28-H Wave 5) — reproduce VP-003/VP-001 RAG schema-validation failures with Wave-3 instrumentation, capture raw_response + field-level validation_errors

runs.note: did NOT reproduce the schema-validation failure this call; parsed successfully (candidates_before=1), then the risk-lexicon cascade correctly stripped all 3 evidence quotes (all risk-laden: 자해/자살/죽고 싶) for the sole 'depression' candidate, eliminating it. Non-deterministic outcome vs EXP-006's same-input run (which failed schema validation). orphan_departments entry present but domain_ref='depression' in eliminated_domains -> cascade side effect, not a genuine orphan (REV-011 sec3 rule iii).

unexpected SUCCESS this call (BUG-019/EXP-006 had failed VP-001/run1 with an identical schema-validation signature). 3 domain_candidates (depression/sleep/anxiety), 11 accepted evidence quotes, 0/11 broader-taxonomy hits, whitelist rejected=0.

root_cause_hypothesis.summary: RetrievedChunk.source_type (schema field, values 'case_card'|'qa' = DB table origin, schemas/domain_inference.py:81, retrieval.py:208/219) and DomainEvidence.source_type (schema field, EvidenceSourceType enum, values 'rag_chunk'|'utterance' = evidence provenance class, schemas/domain_inference.py:35) share the same field name 'source_type' but different value domains. The prompt (_build_user_content, domain_inference.py:83-85) lists each retrieved chunk as '- [{chunk_id}] ({source_type}): {text}' where the parenthetical prints the DB-table-origin value ('case_card' or 'qa') directly adjacent to the chunk_id, in the same visual position the output JSON's evidence[].source_type field occupies. The model intermittently copies this per-chunk table-name annotation (or, worse, the full source_id string) into the JSON evidence[].source_type field instead of the fixed literal 'rag_chunk', which the Pydantic Literal['rag_chunk','utterance'] schema then rejects.
evidence_for: All 4 raw failures/reproductions this batch (VP-003/run1, VP-001/run2) show validation_errors exclusively of type=literal_error on evidence[].source_type, with input values 'qa', 'qa:1502', 'qa:1537', 'qa:532' -- all are qa-table chunk_ids or the bare string 'qa', never a case_card value and never any other field.

Cross-checked EXP-005+EXP-006's shipped (successfully-parsed) RAG artifacts: 24/24 case_card-sourced accepted evidence items have source_type='rag_chunk' (0 anomalies); 2/2 qa-sourced accepted evidence items also correctly show 'rag_chunk' (EXP-006 rag/VP-004/run2) -- confirming the defect is qa-table-specific and intermittent (not 100% reproduction rate), consistent with a stochastic LLM-conflation trigger rather than a deterministic code bug.

VP-001/run1 (this batch's one unexpected success) cited zero qa-table chunks as evidence despite 5 qa: chunk_ids being retrieved and available (chunk_ids list includes qa:1755/831/1581/1707/879) -- consistent with the hypothesis that citing a qa-table chunk is the necessary precondition for the failure to trigger at all.
root_cause_hypothesis.distinction_from_bug016: Same conceptual class as BUG-016 (chunk_id= prefix echo -- the model conflating prompt-listing formatting with a JSON schema field) but a different field and a different confusion: BUG-016 was source_id contamination from an adjacent label string; this is source_type contamination from the per-chunk DB-table-origin annotation, which uses the identical field name 'source_type' for a different value domain than the JSON schema expects.
root_cause_hypothesis.not_established: Not yet confirmed as the sole/complete cause -- 2 of 4 runs this batch did not reproduce a schema-validation failure at all (VP-003/run2 succeeded-then-cascaded, VP-001/run1 succeeded outright with 0 qa-citations), so this is a sufficient-but-observed-only-sometimes trigger; no root-cause fix attempted (out of this brief's scope, developer's Wave 6).
